· MACD histogram trajectory (3151.7916 → 265.9496): improving but significantly slower than prior, weakening bullish expansion signal
· Bollinger Band current price position (Middle Band KRW 256,050): band width 22.16%, indicating contraction phase
[Support & Resistance Structure]

· Swing Resistance (KRW 267,000): based on SMA50 and Pivot R1 (KRW 285,167)
· 5-day/20-day High/Low Pattern (Higher Low): forming higher low pattern, potential for recovery signal
[Volume & Conclusion]
· Volume Ratio (0.34x): contracted vs 5-day average, reducing confidence in price movement
· Current phase diagnosis (Accumulation): maintaining wait-and-see due to lack of buying pressure and absence of trend
